This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

04.
2. Claiming for higher compensation, the petitioner has filed this writ petition.

3. Mr. P.R. Barik, learned counsel for the petitioner contended that claiming for higher compensation, remedy is available under Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, but since the competent authority has not been appointed, the petitioner has approached this Court by filing this writ petition.
